includes: API-accessible AI inference with a recurring or currently usable free allocation
Account-required free APIs and free model pools
Free monthly credits where the provider explicitly grants them to free accounts
Anonymous/keyless free APIs when they are useful to developers
excludes: Chat-only/web-only products with no developer API
Expired or clearly discontinued free programs
Promotions whose free allocation is already known to be over
Providers where a free API claim cannot be traced to a provider or primary technical source

providers.name: Google Gemini API
providers.free_summary: New Gemini API accounts start on the Free Tier with access to selected models within their model-specific free-tier limits.
providers.quota_summary: Model-specific quotas; current exact limits are shown in the account/AI Studio quota view.
providers.privacy_summary: Free-tier data use depends on Google service/data terms and region.
providers.region_notes: Availability and data terms vary by region; check Google's available-regions and terms pages.

providers.name: Groq
providers.free_summary: Groq exposes a Free tier with model-specific request/token limits; payment information is needed only when upgrading to paid usage.
providers.quota_summary: Limits are model and organization specific; the public rate-limit page lists current model ceilings and response headers expose remaining quota.
providers.privacy_summary: Check Groq's current privacy and data-use terms before sending sensitive prompts.
providers.region_notes: Service availability may vary by jurisdiction.

providers.name: Cerebras Inference
providers.free_summary: Cerebras offers a $0 Free tier with lower rate limits and community support.
providers.quota_summary: Exact free-tier limits are account/service dependent; the provider publishes that the Free tier has lower rate limits.
providers.privacy_summary: Review Cerebras terms before production use.
providers.region_notes: Availability may vary.

providers.name: Mistral AI
providers.free_summary: Mistral Studio starts in Free mode by default, with API access and limited included usage; no credit card is required to activate Studio.
providers.quota_summary: Monthly included usage and limits are shown in the account Limits/Subscription views.
providers.privacy_summary: Free-mode inputs and outputs may be subject to Mistral's data-use terms; review current controls before sensitive use.
providers.region_notes: Global plan details and availability may vary.

providers.name: Cohere
providers.free_summary: A Cohere account automatically receives a trial API key. Trial API usage is free but limited.
providers.quota_summary: The documented monthly trial limit is 1,000 calls; endpoint-specific limits also apply.
providers.privacy_summary: Trial access is intended for testing/prototyping; check current terms for commercial and production use.
providers.region_notes: Availability may vary.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.free_summary: OpenRouter's Free plan provides API access to 25+ free models and currently lists a 50 requests/day rate limit.
providers.quota_summary: 50 requests/day on the Free plan; free model availability changes frequently.
providers.privacy_summary: Provider routing and model/provider policies vary; review the selected provider's data policy.
providers.region_notes: Model/provider availability may vary.

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.free_summary: Workers AI is available on Cloudflare's Free plan with 10,000 Neurons/day at no charge.
providers.quota_summary: 10,000 Neurons/day shared across Workers AI usage; limits reset daily at 00:00 UTC.
providers.privacy_summary: Review Cloudflare's data processing terms for the workload and region.
providers.region_notes: Global network; account eligibility and product availability may vary.

providers.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
providers.free_summary: Free Hugging Face users receive $0.10/month in Inference Provider credits, subject to change.
providers.quota_summary: $0.10/month for Free users; additional usage requires purchased credits or another billing arrangement.
providers.privacy_summary: Routed requests are billed and processed through the chosen provider; provider terms apply.
providers.region_notes: Provider/model availability varies.

providers.name: Z AI (Zhipu AI)
providers.free_summary: Z AI publishes selected models at Free pricing, including GLM-4.7-Flash and other free variants.
providers.quota_summary: Limits are model/account specific; published free models may be concurrency limited.
providers.privacy_summary: Review Z AI data and regional terms before sensitive use.
providers.region_notes: International and China endpoints use distinct account/platform flows.

providers.name: ModelScope API-Inference
providers.free_summary: ModelScope provides free API-Inference for registered users under published usage/concurrency limits.
providers.quota_summary: Published limits include 2,000 requests/day total per user, with per-model quotas dynamically adjusted and capped at 500.
providers.privacy_summary: Review Alibaba Cloud/ModelScope terms and regional requirements.
providers.region_notes: Account binding and identity-verification rules can affect eligibility.

providers.name: SiliconFlow
providers.free_summary: SiliconFlow has model-specific free models whose calls are priced at zero after the account requirements are satisfied.
providers.quota_summary: Free-model rate limits are fixed per model; exact limits are exposed by the model catalog.
providers.privacy_summary: Review current China/International service terms and model pricing.
providers.region_notes: China and international sites are separate account systems.

providers.name: Ollama Cloud
providers.free_summary: Ollama Cloud provides a free tier with session and weekly usage limits for supported cloud model families.
providers.quota_summary: Session limits reset every five hours and weekly limits reset every seven days; exact model weighting varies.
providers.privacy_summary: Review Ollama cloud terms before sending sensitive data.
providers.region_notes: Cloud model availability may vary.

providers.name: Kilo Code
providers.free_summary: Kilo Code exposes a free model pool, including an auto-router, with no API key required for the free gateway path.
providers.quota_summary: Published free-gateway access is rate limited; the provider documents 200 requests/hour per IP for the free pool.
providers.privacy_summary: Some routed providers may log prompts/outputs; inspect the provider notice before using sensitive data.
providers.region_notes: Free-pool membership changes frequently.

providers.name: LLM7.io
providers.free_summary: LLM7 offers anonymous access to a free model pool; a free token raises the limits while keeping the same free models.
providers.quota_summary: Anonymous: 10 RPM, 60 requests/hour and 500k tokens/day; free-token limits are higher according to the provider's limits page.
providers.privacy_summary: Review LLM7's terms before sending sensitive prompts.
providers.region_notes: Catalog rotates frequently.

providers.name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
providers.free_summary: OVHcloud AI Endpoints currently offers a free anonymous tier without signup or API key at a low per-IP/per-model rate.
providers.quota_summary: 2 requests/minute per IP per model on the anonymous free path; higher limits are paid.
providers.privacy_summary: Models are hosted in EU data centers; review OVHcloud terms for your workload.
providers.region_notes: Models are hosted in EU data centers.

providers.name: Aion Labs
providers.free_summary: Aion Labs advertises a permanent free tier for its text inference APIs.
providers.quota_summary: Published limits include 15 RPM and 20K tokens/day on the referenced free endpoints.
providers.privacy_summary: Review current provider terms before sensitive use.
providers.region_notes: Availability may vary.

providers.name: OmniRoute
providers.free_summary: OmniRoute is a free MIT-licensed self-hosted AI gateway. It does not provide a single hosted free quota; instead, it lets you connect free providers and route requests through one local OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
providers.quota_summary: No separate OmniRoute quota. Available capacity follows the free or paid quotas of the providers you connect; documented routing supports automatic fallback across them.
providers.privacy_summary: The gateway runs locally by default. Prompts are sent to whichever upstream providers you configure, so upstream provider terms still apply.
providers.region_notes: Local deployment avoids a mandatory OmniRoute-hosted account; upstream provider availability and regional restrictions still apply.

route_guidance.auto: Balanced default: automatic selection among connected providers.
route_guidance.auto/coding: Use for coding and software-engineering tasks.
route_guidance.auto/fast: Use when latency is the primary objective.
route_guidance.auto/cheap: Use when minimizing cost is the primary objective.
route_guidance.auto/offline: Use when maximizing quota/availability headroom is the priority.
route_guidance.auto/smart: Use when prioritizing quality while allowing exploration.

providers.name: Kiro AI (OmniRoute upstream)
providers.identity_verification: not_required_for_omniroute_connection; Kiro itself has account tiers
providers.free_summary: OmniRoute documents Kiro AI as a free upstream connection with no API key required in the OmniRoute provider flow. Kiro itself has a perpetual Free tier with 50 credits/month; the upstream service terms govern access to the models.
providers.quota_summary: Kiro Free currently lists 50 credits per monthly billing cycle; exact model/rate consumption depends on the request. OmniRoute may abstract provider authentication.
providers.privacy_summary: Requests ultimately reach Kiro and are subject to Kiro terms; the local OmniRoute gateway does not remove upstream provider policies.
providers.region_notes: Kiro model availability can vary by country/region.

providers.name: OpenCode Free (OmniRoute upstream)
providers.identity_verification: not_required_for_omniroute_connection; direct OpenCode Zen access may require login/billing details
providers.free_summary: OmniRoute documents an OpenCode Free upstream with no API key required in its provider flow. OpenCode’s own Zen documentation currently describes several free models as available for a limited time, so this entry is not classified as a permanent free tier.
providers.quota_summary: Free-model availability and limits are model-specific and can change; current OpenCode documentation lists free models such as MiMo-V2.5 Free, Ling 3.0 Flash Fin Free, Nemotron 3 Ultra Free, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Free, and Big Pickle.
providers.privacy_summary: Requests are handled by OpenCode and its upstream model providers according to their current terms.
providers.region_notes: Availability may vary by account and model.

providers.name: Pollinations (OmniRoute upstream)
providers.identity_verification: not_required_for_omniroute_connection; direct Pollinations API offers registered and key-based access paths
providers.free_summary: OmniRoute documents Pollinations as a no-key free upstream. Pollinations also maintains an OpenAI-compatible API and multiple access levels; direct API limits and authentication options should be checked against its current API documentation.
providers.quota_summary: No single stable quota is asserted here because Pollinations exposes different free/registered/key-based access paths and model-specific rules; use the provider’s current model metadata and terms.
providers.privacy_summary: Pollinations publishes privacy-focused policies, but requests can route to different upstream model providers; review current data-use terms for sensitive workloads.
providers.region_notes: Provider/model availability can vary.

providers.name: Nara Router
providers.free_summary: Nara currently publishes a Free plan with a daily token allowance and no paid subscription required for the free path.
providers.quota_summary: 7M tokens/day and 15 RPM on the currently published Free plan; the daily pool is shared across its free models.
providers.privacy_summary: Review current Nara terms before proxying third-party models.

providers.name: xKiro
providers.free_summary: xKiro documents a Free plan with access to free-tier models on free accounts.
providers.quota_summary: The current documentation exposes a daily account-level free-token allowance; exact limits are returned by the live usage endpoint.
providers.privacy_summary: Review xKiro terms and upstream model/provider conditions before proxy use.
providers.direct_api_status: Direct API documented; free models are subject to account-level allowance.

providers.name: API Airforce
providers.free_summary: API Airforce documents a Free plan for API experimentation.
providers.quota_summary: Published Free plan limit: 1 RPM and 1,000 requests/day.
providers.privacy_summary: Review provider terms before proxying third-party models.

providers.name: BazaarLink
providers.free_summary: BazaarLink exposes an `auto:free` route and publishes a live set of free models.
providers.quota_summary: Free routing is subject to the provider's current RPM/daily cap; the live /v1/models catalog marks free models with a :free suffix.
providers.privacy_summary: Do not assume upstream proxying is permitted for every model; inspect live provider terms.

providers.name: NavyAI
providers.free_summary: NavyAI currently advertises a $0 Free plan for API use.
providers.quota_summary: The current public plan page advertises 150K tokens/day and 20 RPM.
providers.privacy_summary: Review current NavyAI terms and model-specific restrictions before use.

providers.name: AI Horde
providers.free_summary: AI Horde provides community-backed AI inference that is free of charge, with anonymous use supported.
providers.quota_summary: Availability and speed depend on the community worker pool rather than a fixed commercial token quota.
providers.privacy_summary: Community-hosted inference has different trust characteristics from a first-party API.
providers.direct_api_status: Native Horde API; not an OpenAI-compatible direct endpoint.

providers.name: SEA-LION API
providers.free_summary: AI Singapore provides a free SEA-LION API for proof-of-concept development and testing.
providers.quota_summary: 10 requests/minute on the free API; intended for POC use rather than production workloads.
providers.privacy_summary: Review AI Singapore terms and privacy policy.

providers.name: Baidu Qianfan ERNIE
providers.free_summary: Baidu documents long-term free access for selected ERNIE services after real-name verification.
providers.quota_summary: Free RPM/TPM quotas are console-controlled; use the current Qianfan console as the exact source of limits.
providers.privacy_summary: Review Baidu Cloud and Qianfan data-use terms.
providers.region_notes: The free entitlement requires real-name verification.

providers.name: DeepSeek API
providers.free_summary: OmniRoute's current September 2026 catalog records a one-time free signup grant for the DeepSeek API.
providers.quota_summary: Current catalog evidence records 5M free tokens on signup for a limited period; confirm current account eligibility before relying on it.
providers.privacy_summary: Review DeepSeek Open Platform data-use terms before sending sensitive prompts.

providers.name: Google Cloud Vertex AI
providers.free_summary: New Google Cloud customers can receive $300 in free credits that may be used for eligible Vertex AI workloads.
providers.quota_summary: $300 new-customer cloud credit; one-time trial rather than a permanent API quota.
providers.privacy_summary: Vertex AI follows Google Cloud service/data terms.

providers.name: Hyperbolic
providers.free_summary: OmniRoute's current catalog records a signup credit for Hyperbolic API experimentation.
providers.quota_summary: Signup credit is one-time rather than a recurring free allowance; confirm the live account offer.
providers.privacy_summary: Review Hyperbolic terms before proxying upstream models.

providers.name: LongCat API
providers.free_summary: OmniRoute's current free catalog records a one-time LongCat free allocation; the LongCat platform provides a first-party OpenAI-compatible API.
providers.quota_summary: Current OmniRoute evidence records a one-time 10M-token free allocation; verify the live LongCat account quota before use.
providers.privacy_summary: Use the provider's current terms and API-key handling guidance.

providers.name: Morph
providers.free_summary: Morph publishes an OpenAI-compatible API with 200 free requests every month.
providers.quota_summary: 200 requests/month free; hosted model usage after the free allowance is usage-priced.
providers.privacy_summary: Morph's EULA permits personal and commercial use within the free-tier limits; standard data handling applies.

providers.name: Public AI Gateway
providers.free_summary: Public AI documents a Free tier with API access to public and sovereign models.
providers.quota_summary: The current Free tier is documented at 100 requests/minute; paid/Plus plans increase that limit.
providers.privacy_summary: Review Public AI's current terms and provider-specific model policies.

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM
providers.free_summary: NVIDIA NIM provides API access to selected models for NVIDIA Developer Program members, subject to model-specific limits.
providers.quota_summary: The reference snapshot lists 40 RPM and 10,000 requests/day for its included models; check the current NVIDIA model page for live limits.
providers.privacy_summary: NVIDIA and model-specific terms apply; review current conditions before sensitive or production use.
providers.region_notes: Access depends on current NVIDIA Developer Program eligibility and model catalog.

glossary.M: Million tokens when used in quota/size notation
glossary.free_tier_type: How the provider's zero-cost access is structured
